name: daemon-ownership-and-security
task_summary: Complete daemon-only ownership, protocol safety, remote ownership, and tests

spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Complete the daemon-side root architecture for Ferryx terminal persistence, test-first, so the daemon is the sole PTY and remote-gateway owner and GUI clients never cause fallback PTYs.
DELIVERABLE: Modify ONLY src-tauri/src/daemon/protocol.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/server.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/client.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/mod.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/launchd.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/output_hub.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/service.rs, src-tauri/src/terminal/tests.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/state.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/server.rs, src-tauri/src/remote/tests.rs, plus tests inside those owned module files. First write RED tests, then implement the smallest correct changes. The current code is partially v2: protocol has version 2, Spawn(clientRequestId,cwd), Attach(afterSequence), sequenced Output, daemon epoch, and dedicated attach streams. It is incomplete in these concrete ways:
1. Daemon lacks a typed RegisterWorkspace request and currently infers/registers a "default" project from its own CWD. Add typed workspace registration with canonical repository-root validation; spawn must resolve only daemon-registered workspace/worktree identity and reject arbitrary cwd outside that registered root.
2. get_runtime_dir/run_server currently creates /tmp/rorca-{uid} and blindly unlinks daemon.sock. Add lstat/UID/mode checks: reject symlink runtime directory/socket/lock, reject foreign ownership, enforce 0700 directory and 0600 socket/lock, and remove a stale socket only after proving lock is available and ownership is safe. Internal .rorca/rorca identifiers remain compatible.
3. DaemonClient connect_or_spawn currently loops with fixed 50ms sleep/poll. Replace it with a bounded event-driven readiness path based on standalone ferryx --daemon stdout token FERRYX_DAEMON_READY (with one connection attempt after readiness); no in-process server, no silent fallback.
4. DaemonServer currently starts the remote gateway by default and GUI still has its own TerminalService-backed RemoteGatewayState. Make the daemon own remote state/listener lifecycle explicitly and expose typed protocol requests/responses plus client methods for remote status, configure enable/disable, pairing create, device list/revoke, and active selection set/get. Do not start a network listener by default. The daemon remote gateway must use its same TerminalService; remote session listing/attach/write/resize/signal must observe daemon-owned sessions.
5. Current stream lag reports a metadata-only Gap ignored by the GUI. Emit a typed replay-gap frame containing requested/available sequences plus history start/end and base64 history; on broadcast lag replay after last emitted sequence, never an unbounded full snapshot unless the gap requires it.
6. Spawn idempotency cache must be bounded by a short TTL and only return a still-live session; a repeated clientRequestId must never create a second shell.
7. Protocol mismatch must return a typed explicit error and never create an in-process PTY.
Write source-level unit tests inside your scope for every item that fail under the pre-change behavior. Do not change GUI lib/ipc/UI/integration test files or commit.
SCOPE: You own only the explicitly listed daemon, terminal, and remote module files. Do not modify files outside this list. This executable assignment does not authorize any Git operation.
VERIFY: Run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml daemon:: --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml terminal:: --lib; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml remote:: --lib; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. All must exit 0. Report each RED command/result, GREEN command/result, every changed file, and a concise public protocol handoff table for the Tauri bridge.
STOP WHEN: The listed daemon-only ownership/security/replay contracts are implemented and tested with all four commands green, and no out-of-scope files were touched.

final_response:
I read this as a completed daemon-architecture delivery - the owned changes are implemented, tested, and verified with the requested commands.

Implemented daemon-only ownership and persistence contracts:

- Explicit canonical `RegisterWorkspace`; no daemon-CWD/default workspace inference.
- Spawn resolves only registered workspace/worktree identity and rejects CWD and symlink escapes.
- Secure runtime directory, lock, and socket handling with UID/type/symlink/mode validation.
- Stale sockets are removed only after acquiring the daemon lock.
- External daemon startup waits for the exact `FERRYX_DAEMON_READY` stdout event, then makes one connection attempt.
- Daemon owns persistent remote state, listener lifecycle, authentication, active selection, and the same `TerminalService` used by PTYs.
- Remote listener remains off unless explicitly enabled or restored from daemon-persisted configuration.
- Typed replay-gap frames include sequence boundaries and base64 history.
- Lag recovery replays only after the last emitted sequence, bounded by retained history.
- Concurrent duplicate spawn requests are serialized; request caching is TTL-bounded and never creates a second live shell.
- Protocol mismatch returns `ProtocolMismatch` and closes the connection without creating a PTY.
- Natural terminal exit now closes the daemon-owned output-hub stream.

### Public protocol handoff for the Tauri bridge

| Client method / operation | Request | Success response | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Connection handshake | `Handshake { version }` | `HandshakeOk { version, pid, epoch }` | Mismatch returns typed `ProtocolMismatch { expectedVersion, receivedVersion }`; connection then closes. |
| Workspace registration | `RegisterWorkspace { workspaceId, repoRoot }` | `RegisterWorkspaceOk` | `repoRoot` must be an absolute, canonical Git repository root. |
| Spawn terminal | `Spawn { clientRequestId, workspaceId, worktree, cwd, cols, rows }` | `SpawnOk { sessionId }` | Workspace must already be registered. CWD must remain inside the resolved workspace/worktree root. |
| Describe terminal | `DescribeSession { sessionId }` | `DescribeSessionOk { session }` | Includes workspace/worktree identity, CWD, size, running state, and retained sequence range. |
| Attach terminal | `Attach { sessionId, afterSequence }` | `AttachOk { epoch, sessionId, startSequence, endSequence, gap, history }` | Uses a dedicated connection and base64 history. |
| Live output | N/A | `Output { sessionId, sequence, data }` | `data` is base64. |
| Lag recovery | N/A | `replayGap { sessionId, requestedAfterSequence, availableFromSequence, startSequence, endSequence, history }` | `history` is base64 and bounded by retained history. |
| Terminal exit | N/A | `Exit { sessionId, exitCode }` | Output stream closes on natural PTY exit. |
| Write | `Write { sessionId, data }` | `WriteOk` | `data` is base64. |
| Resize | `Resize { sessionId, cols, rows }` | `ResizeOk` | Operates on daemon-owned PTY. |
| Signal | `Signal { sessionId, signal }` | `SignalOk` | Operates on daemon-owned PTY. |
| Close | `Close { sessionId }` | `CloseOk` | Removes daemon session metadata and output history. |
| List sessions | `ListSessions` | `ListSessionsOk { epoch, sessions }` | Sessions are daemon-owned. |
| Remote status | `RemoteGetStatus` | `RemoteStatusOk { status }` | Status includes mode, port, control flag, running state, and bound address. |
| Remote configure | `RemoteConfigure { config }` | `RemoteConfigureOk` | `mode: off` stops the listener; enabled modes bind through the daemon. |
| Pairing code | `RemoteCreatePairingCode { permission }` | `RemotePairingCodeOk { code }` | Default permission is control when omitted. |
| Device list | `RemoteListDevices` | `RemoteListDevicesOk { devices }` | Reads daemon-owned authentication state. |
| Device revoke | `RemoteRevokeDevice { deviceId }` | `RemoteRevokeDeviceOk` | Unknown/already-revoked device returns `Error`. |
| Set active selection | `RemoteSetActiveSelection { selection }` | `RemoteSetActiveSelectionOk` | Selection contains safe workspace/worktree/session identifiers. |
| Get active selection | `RemoteGetActiveSelection` | `RemoteGetActiveSelectionOk { selection }` | Remote terminal exposure follows this daemon-owned selection. |
| General failure | Any | `Error { message }` | Operational/validation errors; protocol mismatch uses the dedicated typed response. |
